auto_stash.always.help: You can change this in Preferences > General.
auto_stash.body.checkout: Glowfly stashes them, checks out {target} and puts them back afterwards.
auto_stash.body.cherry_pick: Glowfly stashes them, cherry-picks {commits} onto {onto} and puts them back afterwards.
auto_stash.body.gitflow_finish: Glowfly stashes them, finishes {branch} and puts them back afterwards.
auto_stash.body.gitflow_start: Glowfly stashes them, starts {branch} and puts them back on it afterwards.
auto_stash.body.merge: Glowfly stashes them, merges {from} into {into} and puts them back afterwards.
auto_stash.body.pr_checkout: Glowfly stashes them, checks out {branch} for {pr} and puts them back afterwards.
auto_stash.body.pull: Glowfly stashes them, pulls into {branch} and puts them back afterwards.
auto_stash.body.rebase: Glowfly stashes them, rebases {branch} onto {onto} and puts them back afterwards.
auto_stash.body.reset: Stash and reset puts them back after resetting {branch} to {commit}. Discard and reset leaves them in a stash that only Undo brings back.
auto_stash.body.restack: Glowfly stashes them, restacks the branches onto {onto} and puts them back on the branch checked out now.
auto_stash.body.revert: Glowfly stashes them, reverts {commits} on {branch} and puts them back afterwards.
auto_stash.body.stops: If it stops on conflicts, they come back after you continue or abort.
auto_stash.log.failed: Couldn't put back "{name}": {reason} The stash stays in the list, so nothing is lost.
auto_stash.no_longer_waiting: Stopped waiting to put back "{name}"; it stays in the stash list.
auto_stash.saved.body: Glowfly stashed your changes as "{name}" and hadn't put them back when it last closed. Put them back now?
auto_stash.saved.body.dirty: They go on top of the changes you have now.
auto_stash.saved.gone: The stash "{name}" Glowfly was keeping to put back is no longer in the list.
auto_stash.saved.title: Stashed changes waiting
auto_stash.show.gone: That stash is no longer in the list.
auto_stash.title: Uncommitted changes
auto_stash.toast.back_unstaged: Your changes from "{name}" are back, but unstaged: what was staged no longer fit the index.
auto_stash.toast.conflict.one: Putting back "{name}" conflicted in {count} file; the stash is kept.
auto_stash.toast.conflict.other: Putting back "{name}" conflicted in {count} files; the stash is kept.
auto_stash.toast.failed: Couldn't put back "{name}"; the stash is kept.
auto_stash.toast.gone: The stash "{name}" is no longer in the list, so there was nothing to put back.
auto_stash.toast.made: Stashed your changes as "{name}". They come back when you continue or abort.
